scientific_integrity: The infinite-family theorem is analytically proved. Finite exact/numerical checks are corroboration, not exhaustive proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform-stationary symmetric time-homogeneous Markov chains. General SDP and equal-alphabet Hamming solutions predate this work; related unindexed literature might contain an equivalent mixed-alphabet uniqueness theorem. Independent audit not performed.
title: Unique fastest mixing on mixed-alphabet Hamming graphs
